1 زَبَقَ , (IF, S, Msb, K,) aor.
زَبِقَ (A 'Obeyd, S, K) and
زَبُقَ , (K,) inf. n. زَبْقٌ, (TA,) He plucked out (IF, S, Msb, K) his hair, (IF, S,) or the hair, (Msb,) or his beard. (K.) ―
-b2- زَبَقَتْ بِوَلَدِهَا She (a woman) cast forth her child. (Ibn-Buzurj, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, (K,) inf. n. as above, (TA,) He mixed a thing with (بِ) another thing. (K.) ―
-b2- He made a man to enter into (فِى) a thing, and a house, or tent, or chamber. (IKh, TA.) ―
-b3- He confined a man (As, A 'Obeyd, IF, K) in a prison. (TA.) ―
-b4- He straitened a man. (TA.) ―
-b5- He made fast, or bound or tied fast or firmly, a sheep, or goat, and a lamb, or kid, round the neck, with a cord; like رَبَقَ بِحَبْلٍ. (IKh, TA.) ＝
-A3- Also He broke a thing. (TA.) ―
-b2- And He opened a lock. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
